title: PNP chief orders full use of tech, intelligence to track fugitives

blocks.text: MANILA — Philippine National Police (PNP) chief Police General Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. has ordered police units to maximize available technology and intelligence resources to track down wanted persons and prevent them from escaping through the country's coastal exit points.
